title: Harmonize icon-only button press affordance and theme edge-case handling
creator: Asha Patel
description: Multiple regressions were reported after the token consolidation work: icon-only buttons show inconsistent hit targets across themes, disabled treatment visually conflicts with spinner overlay in dark theme, and some token fallbacks cause 1px outline shifts on focus. This ticket scopes a design and token-level fix that preserves current compact layouts while restoring accessible hit areas, predictable spinner stacking, and consistent theming across legacy and new token sets.
acceptance_criteria: Icon-only buttons across light/dark/high-contrast themes have a minimum 40x40px interactive area (visual or invisible hit target) without altering surrounding layout.
Loading spinner overlays for icon and compound buttons never overlap label text or adjacent icons; stacking order documented in tokens.
Disabled state contrast and opacity values are aligned to the consolidated token set and pass WCAG AA for disabled states where required.
Token fallback rules added so theme switches do not produce 1px layout shifts on focus or press across supported browsers.
Design spec and code PR include visual regression screenshots (storyshots) for the 4 affected themes and are approved by engineering and accessibility review.
tasks: Audit existing icon-button usages in Console and Quickstarts to identify layout-sensitive placements
Add invisible hit target token (button.hitSize) and document usage rules in tokens page
Design spinner stacking token (button.spinnerZIndex) and spacing constraints for icon/compound buttons
Prototype behavior in Figma with both old and new tokens; capture before/after overlays
Coordinate with engineering: provide a small test harness and jest/visual test guidance
Ship a small token migration PR + component variant that flips new behavior behind a feature flag for canary rollout
